fold_aggregation: unweighted mean metric_error across exactly 3 folds per tid-framework
primary_raw_metric_rule: largest classification metric stratum by total task count; ties lexicographic
normalized_definition: within-task affine transform of score over the frozen framework set to [0,1], constant row -> 0.5
rank_definition: within-task average rank over the frozen framework set, larger score = higher rank score
support_control: intersection of observed CC18/outside log1p(NumberOfInstances) ranges, followed by size-stratified permutations using q=3,4,5 bins
